title: FrameMorrow: Future-guided Frame Selection with Prospective Tokens for Long-Horizon Video Generation
title_zh: FrameMorrow：面向长期视频生成的未来引导式帧选择——基于前瞻性标记的方法

paragraphs.en: FrameMorrow 利用前瞻令牌预测未来信息需求，从历史中选帧，提升长视频生成一致性。 Long-horizon video generation requires models to effectively leverage an increasingly long generation history. As the generated history grows, retaining all previous content becomes increasingly expensive and redundant, making effective historical selection essential. Existing approaches often determine historical relevance based on the current content. However, information relevant to the present is not necessarily useful for future generation, while seemingly less relevant history may become important later. Our key insight is that historical information should be selected according to its relevance to future information needs. Capturing these needs does not require generating the full future; instead, a compact representation of what becomes important next is sufficient to guide historical selection. Building on this insight, we propose FrameMorrow, a prospective frame selector that predicts a small set of prospective tokens representing future information needs and uses them to identify relevant information from history. FrameMorrow selects explicit historical frames rather than model-specific internal states, enabling plug-and-play integration across diverse generators, including closed-source models, with little additional inference cost. We evaluate FrameMorrow across five benchmarks and 11 generative models spanning long-video generation, interactive generation, and action-conditioned world models. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in long-range consistency, visual quality, and action alignment across diverse generation settings.
paragraphs.zh: FrameMorrow 利用前瞻令牌预测未来信息需求，从历史中选帧，提升长视频生成一致性。长时程视频生成要求模型能够有效利用日益增长的生成历史。 随着生成历史的不断增长，保留全部先前内容变得越来越昂贵且冗余，因此有效的历史选择至关重要。 现有方法通常根据当前内容来判断历史内容的相关性。 然而，与当前相关的信息未必对未来的生成有用，而看似相关性较低的历史内容之后可能变得重要。 我们的核心洞察是：历史信息应根据其与未来信息需求的相关性来选择。 捕捉这些需求并不需要生成完整的未来；相反，一个紧凑的、表示接下来什么将变得重要的表示形式就足以指导历史选择。 基于这一洞察，我们提出了 FrameMorrow，一种前瞻性的帧选择器，它预测一小组代表未来信息需求的前瞻令牌，并利用它们从历史中识别相关信息。 FrameMorrow 选择的是显式的历史帧而非模型特定的内部状态，因此可以作为即插即用的组件集成到多种生成器中，包括闭源模型，且几乎没有额外的推理成本。 我们在五个基准和 11 个生成模型上评估了 FrameMorrow，涵盖长视频生成、交互式生成以及动作条件世界模型。 大量实验表明，在各种生成设置下，FrameMorrow 在长程一致性、视觉质量和动作对齐方面均带来持续提升。
